prompts.01:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: original editorial photograph for an Instagram carousel teaching parents to help a child plan a videogame with three drawings. Produce a landscape 1536x1024 photograph, no typography or graphic overlay.
Scene: warm contemporary Brazilian home, light oak desk, soft daylight. Close three-quarter overhead camera. Only hands and forearms of a fictional 11-year-old girl, medium warm brown skin, plain cornflower-blue long-sleeved sweatshirt. One ordinary white A4 sheet lies horizontally on the desk, folded with exactly two vertical crease lines dividing it into THREE equal panels. The left panel has a small unfinished pencil-and-colored-pencil sketch of a friendly pirate with a red shirt and dark hat standing on a short brown platform; the middle and right panels are completely blank. Girl's right hand holds a normal yellow graphite pencil poised above the CENTER blank panel, hesitating and thinking what comes next; left hand gently rests on bottom-left edge, not covering the sketch. Three colored pencils, red blue and yellow, on table edge. Sheet large and clearly visible, all three panels visible; hands anatomically correct with five fingers each; pencil grip natural. Camera height fairly high, paper feels nearly horizontal. Warm white paper, saturated blue sleeve, restrained yellow accents, rich real textures. This is not a screenshot, no computers in this cover, no words, letters, captions, logos, watermark, arrows, invented UI, or school assignment headings. Framing will be cropped mildly on vertical edges in a slide; center all essential paper content. Natural beautiful editorial photograph, believable drawing by an 11-year-old, not glossy stock or childish preschool cartoon.
